research_summary: Current results mix legacy Brsk reviews with deal pages that still describe orderable plans. The official Brsk homepage now redirects to YouFibre and Uswitch explicitly dates the retail-brand retirement to March 2026. The most useful page therefore preserves Brsk search intent while answering the transition first, then supplies clearly dated legacy product details and a safe current next step.
depth_rationale: Ranking provider reviews generally cover roughly 1,700 to 2,400 words and include plans, speeds, coverage, equipment, support and FAQs. A 1,500-word minimum is sufficient here because the live commercial choice has collapsed into YouFibre, but the page still needs detailed legacy context for existing customers and searchers encountering outdated offers.
